thread:
maya_swe: FYI found a weird UX gap in the sampleapp where we recommend prefetch=4 by default. users hitting quotas with embedded backends get surprising 429s during onboarding.
oliver_sre: what's surprising? do we show quota/limits in console?
maya_swe: not on the quickstart flow. people run sampleapp, see 429s and assume runtime is flaky.
ben_doc: suggests change: lower default prefetch to 1 and surface a short note that says "If you see 429s during onboarding, reduce prefetch or enable adaptive backpressure in client config."
ci-bot: opened ticket DEVEX-1102 "sampleapp-prefetch-default-lower"
maya_swe: also propose adding a small troubleshooting snippet showing how to detect auth refresh vs backend rate limit in logs.
ben_doc: will draft snippet and update quickstart. also add a short FAQ blurb in docs.
